RUINA2-GLIMPSE_OF_EGO.description: Upon pickup, obtain a random [gold]EGO[/gold] card to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
RUINA2-GLIMPSE_OF_EGO.flavor: The human mind holds infinite potential. This is but a tiny sliver of it.
RUINA2-GLIMPSE_OF_EGO.title: Glimpse of EGO
RUINA2-BOOK_OF_EGO.description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]EGO[/gold] cards to add to your Deck, and add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Decay[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
RUINA2-BOOK_OF_EGO.eventDescription: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]EGO[/gold] cards to add to your Deck. Add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Decay[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
RUINA2-BOOK_OF_EGO.flavor: There is a light within all of us. A light that will one day break free and change the world.
RUINA2-BOOK_OF_EGO.title: Book of EGO
RUINA2-GOODBYE.description: The first [gold]Attack[/gold] you play each combat deals double damage.
RUINA2-GOODBYE.flavor: It tries to mimic humans. Looking into a mirror, mumbling to itself, trying to fix its skeletal structure . . . it's as if it was trying to become human.
RUINA2-GOODBYE.title: Goodbye
RUINA2-FALSE_PRESENT.description: Upon pickup, lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] Max HP. The first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards you draw each combat cost [blue]0[/blue] until played.
RUINA2-FALSE_PRESENT.flavor: Poor Ozma. She didn't know that lying adults don't approach others without reason.
RUINA2-FALSE_PRESENT.title: False Present
RUINA2-PRESCRIPTS_GRACE.description: At start of each turn, randomly chooses between [gold]Attack[/gold], [gold]Skill[/gold], and [gold]Power[/gold]. The first card you play each turn of the chosen type is played twice.
RUINA2-PRESCRIPTS_GRACE.flavor: It all made sense now. All those pointless endeavours converged onto a single, definite meaning.
RUINA2-PRESCRIPTS_GRACE.title: Prescript's Grace
RUINA2-MALICE.description: At the start of your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] to ALL enemies. If your HP is at or below [blue]{HPThreshold}%[/blue], deal [blue]{IncreasedDamage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies instead.
RUINA2-MALICE.flavor: The inherent malice caused all life to crumble as soon as it bloomed.
RUINA2-MALICE.title: Malice
RUINA2-SEVENTH_BULLET.description: Gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] at the start of combat. Whenever you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Attacks[/gold], take [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage.
RUINA2-SEVENTH_BULLET.flavor: One day, the marksman realized the Devil no longer followed him. He pondered why, then realized that his soul had already fallen to Hell from the beginning.
RUINA2-SEVENTH_BULLET.title: The Seventh Bullet
RUINA2-OVEREXERTION.description: Start each combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}. Gain [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Frail[/gold] at the start of your second turn.
RUINA2-OVEREXERTION.flavor: She just had to keep pushing forward. Keep on pushing until the way was clear. Keep on pushing until she could push no more.
RUINA2-OVEREXERTION.title: Overexertion
RUINA2-LIFE_FIBERS.description: The next time you die, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP instead. At the end of combat, increase the heal amount by [blue]{HealIncrease}[/blue].
RUINA2-LIFE_FIBERS.flavor: When night falls in the Backstreets, they will come.
RUINA2-LIFE_FIBERS.title: Life Fibers
RUINA2-LOWELLS_GIFT.description: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
RUINA2-LOWELLS_GIFT.flavor: It's those small moments you end up remembering for the rest of your life.
RUINA2-LOWELLS_GIFT.title: Lowell's Gift
RUINA2-FOUR_TRIGRAMS.description:
At the start of your turn, activate the effect that corresponds to the current turn:
[blue]1st[/blue] turn - Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card.
[blue]2nd[/blue] turn - Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
[blue]3rd[/blue] turn - Gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
[blue]4th[/blue] turn - Gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
RUINA2-FOUR_TRIGRAMS.flavor: The balance of the City must be upheld.
RUINA2-FOUR_TRIGRAMS.title: Four Trigrams
RUINA2-BOOK_OF_SOMEONE.description: At the end of combat, heal [blue]{Heal}%[/blue] of your HP.
RUINA2-BOOK_OF_SOMEONE.flavor: Some must fight so that all may be free.
RUINA2-BOOK_OF_SOMEONE.title: Book of Someone
